item.title: Boys basketball district final scoreboard
item.description: Below is a list of all the district finals games, organized by division and district number, for teams covered by outlets in the MediaNews Group Michigan cluster — the Mt. Pleasant Morning Sun, the Macomb Daily, the Oakland Press, and the Southgate News Herald — on Friday, Feb. 27, 2026.

item.title: Lions’ Terrion Arnold denies alleged link to robbery, kidnapping case in Florida
item.description: Detroit Lions cornerback Terrion Arnold is denying his alleged link to an armed robbery and kidnapping case in Florida after his name appeared in court documents this week.

item.title: Falcons dismiss ex-UM assistant coach LaTroy Lewis, who has been named a suspect in a sexual assault case
item.description: The Atlanta Falcons dismissed assistant defensive line coach LaTroy Lewis on Friday, just hours before he was named as a suspect in a sexual assault case. The dismissal came shortly after the Falcons said they were looking into allegations that surfaced on social media.

item.title: Photos of Bloomfield Hills vs. Brother Rice in a D1 boys hoops district championship
item.description: Brother Rice defeated Bloomfield Hills 67-56 in a Division 1 boys basketball district final at Southfield A&T on Friday, February 27, 2026.

item.title: No. 3 Michigan claims Big Ten regular-season title with an 84-70 win over No. 10 Illinois
item.description: Morez Johnson Jr. had 19 points and 11 rebounds against his former team as No. 3 Michigan defeated No. 10 Illinois 84-70 on Friday night and clinched Big Ten regular-season title.

item.title: Pistons outlast short-handed Cavaliers 122-119 in OT after blaring horn delay
item.description: Jalen Duren had 33 points and 16 rebounds and the Detroit Pistons outlasted the short-handed Cleveland Cavaliers 122-119 on Friday night in a game that was delayed for 18 minutes in the third quarter because of a blaring horn.

item.title: Brother Rice switches up its defense, pulls away from Bloomfield Hills in district final
item.description: Needing a boost in the second quarter, Brother Rice boys basketball coach Rick Palmer dug into his back of tricks.

item.title: Photos of Auburn Hills Avondale vs. Clarkston in a D1 boys hoops district championship
item.description: The Avondale Yellow Jackets defeated the Clarkston Wolves 57-43 to win a D1 district title on Friday, Feb. 27, 2026 in Lake Orion.

item.title: Avondale beats Clarkston third time this season for first district championship since 2015
item.description: The Avondale Yellow Jackets dominated the middle two quarters and claimed their first district title in over a decade with a 57-43 win over the Clarkston Wolves on Friday night.

item.title: Top-ranked Detroit Catholic Central too much for Dakota in quarterfinals
item.description: Macomb Dakota did something that few wrestling teams have been able to do against Detroit Catholic Central this season. Build an early lead on the Shamrocks.
